monitoring.title: Seismic Monitoring Network
monitoring.sensitivityDesc: Higher sensitivity makes it easier to detect earthquakes, but increases false detections.
monitoring.hypoDesc1: When enabled, the software will use station data to estimate possible hypocenter locations.
monitoring.hypoDesc2: Experimental feature. Low precision. Does not represent any authoritative source. For reference only.
monitoring.hypoDesc3: Enabling higher detection sensitivity can slightly improve estimation accuracy.
monitoring.hypoDesc4: This feature consumes more computer resources.

behavior.title: Behavior

filter.title: Filter Settings
filter.whitelistDesc: Events whose place name contains keywords will always pass the filter. Use "|" to separate multiple keywords.
filter.filterAnd: All conditions below are AND logic.
filter.filterFromNext: Takes effect starting from the next event.
filter.magThresholdDesc: Only alert when estimated magnitude reaches the threshold. Set to "0" for no filter.
filter.localIntThresholdDesc: Requires "Force Estimate Intensity (Low Precision)". Only alert when estimated local intensity reaches the threshold. Applies to regions outside Japan. Set to "0" for no filter.
filter.localShindoThresholdDesc: Requires "Force Estimate Intensity (Low Precision)". Only alert when estimated local shindo reaches the threshold. Applies to Japan regions with intensity observation points. Set to "0" for no filter.

personalize.title: Personalization
personalize.modeLatestAll: Show Latest Earthquake from All Sources
personalize.alwaysLatest: Always Show Latest Earthquake Info Box
personalize.hideDrawerDesc: When on the earthquake/tsunami page with auto-view enabled, click the same menu item again to toggle.

performance.title: Performance
performance.bitmapRenderDesc: Some layers use Canvas renderer. Slightly improves performance, but graphics may appear blurry in rare cases. Disables "Show Place Names on Map Hover". Requires page reload.
performance.disableIntensityDesc: Completely removes intensity/shindo layer. Does not affect local intensity calculation. Greatly improves performance. Requires page reload.
performance.simplifyDesc: Simplifies the shape of intensity/shindo/tsunami layers to improve performance. Higher simplification reduces rendering load but increases distortion. Requires page reload.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.forceCalcIntDesc: The software estimates the following: local intensity/shindo, max intensity for CN/KR regional EEW and eqlist, max shindo for JP regional EEW (merged with source data), max intensity for some data sources. Estimates may differ from source data.
advanced.warningHighResource: This feature consumes more computer resources.
advanced.warningNeedReload: Some features require page reload to take effect.
advanced.classicMapDesc: ON: Fixes grid artifacts on map; no drag-loading, no cyclic map display. OFF: Supports drag-loading and cyclic map display but may show grid artifacts.
advanced.antiFlickerDesc: Only enable if you experience flickering issues. Fixes frequent flickering caused by unknown reasons. Requires page reload.
advanced.mockEewDesc: When enabled, you can open the Mock EEW panel via Status Panel or [M] key. Educational use only. Misuse consequences are your own responsibility. Requires page reload.
advanced.mockOnReplay: Create Mock Warning When Replaying Stations
advanced.mockOnReplayDesc: When enabled, clicking "Station Replay" on a historical earthquake automatically creates a mock EEW with matching parameters. Some agencies' reported times differ from actual origin times (e.g., JMA uses detection time), which may prevent accurate replay. The created warning uses a virtual origin time and will not auto-update.

notificationMessages.fssnConfirmMsg:
FAN Studio Seismic Network (FSSN) is a project supported by FAN Studio that uses seismometer networks such as FDSN for global earthquake determination.
This project is maintained by seismology enthusiasts and is not an official agency. The determination results are for reference only.
Do you insist on using it?

intensityReference.csis1: Level 1 & below: Barely felt on lower floors, slightly felt on upper floors.
intensityReference.csis2_3: Level 2~3: Slightly felt on lower floors, noticeably felt on upper floors; hanging objects swing slightly.
intensityReference.csis4_5: Level 4~5: Felt by everyone at rest; some sleepers awaken; hanging objects swing noticeably.
intensityReference.csis6_7: Level 6~7: Frightening; most sleepers awaken; some objects fall; poorly built buildings may be damaged.
intensityReference.csis8_9: Level 8~9: Difficult to walk; furniture falls; poorly built buildings may collapse; well-built buildings may be damaged.
intensityReference.csis10_plus: Level 10+: Difficult to stand; feeling of being thrown; large-scale building collapse; terrain changes.
intensityReference.shindo1: Shindo 1: Felt by few people at rest.
intensityReference.shindo2: Shindo 2: Felt by many at rest; hanging objects swing slightly.
intensityReference.shindo3: Shindo 3: Felt by everyone at rest; some sleepers awaken; hanging objects swing noticeably.
intensityReference.shindo4: Shindo 4: Frightening; most sleepers awaken; some objects fall.
intensityReference.shindo5: Shindo 5 Lower~Upper: Difficulty walking; some furniture falls.
intensityReference.shindo6: Shindo 6 Lower~Upper: Difficulty walking; large-scale furniture falling; poorly built buildings may be damaged or collapse.
intensityReference.shindo7: Shindo 7: Unable to stand; feeling of being thrown; large-scale building collapse; terrain changes.

about.disclaimer1: This application is for learning purposes only.
about.disclaimer2: This application uses unofficial data sources and may contain errors. Please refer to official sources for all information.
about.disclaimer3: This application is a permanently free public welfare project and does not accept any form of donation. Any solicitation of fees in the name of this application is fraud. Commercial use is strictly prohibited.
about.disclaimer4: When using this app for the first time, click the Settings icon in the top-right corner of the main screen to personalize.
about.usageApp: Windows 10, macOS 11, Ubuntu 22.04 and above 64-bit users are recommended to download the desktop app.
about.usageMainFeatures: Main features: Receive earthquake early warnings from China, Japan, and Korea; receive regional earthquake information from China, Japan, Korea, etc., as well as global earthquake information from USGS and FAN Studio Seismic Network (FSSN); receive tsunami information from Japan; display real-time seismic monitoring networks from some Japanese and Korean agencies and alert on possible seismic events.
about.usageNotification: Notifications: Requires notification permission. Chrome: Click the padlock icon next to the URL → Site Settings → Notifications → Allow, then refresh.
about.usageSound: Sound: Requires audio permission. Chrome: Click the padlock icon next to the URL → Site Settings → Sound → Allow, then refresh.
about.shortcutInfoCycle: [,] / [.]: Cycle through info pages when multiple pages exist
about.faqIntensity: About Intensity: Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Korea use the intensity scale (12-level, I~XII). Japan and Taiwan use the seismic intensity scale (10-level, 0~7, with levels 5 and 6 split into Lower/Upper). Some values are estimated, not measured.
about.faqTime: About Time: Except for global networks (USGS, FSSN) which show China Standard Time, all others show the local time of the issuing agency.
about.faqDelay: About Delay: Due to API and server limitations, some data may experience latency. This is normal.
about.faqMap: About Map: Due to server bandwidth limitations, the map may take some time to load after entering the page. If the map doesn't load for a long time, please refresh the page.
about.creditsApi: Wolfx Open API, FAN Studio API, P2P Earthquake Information: API Support.
about.creditsSound: kotoho7: SREV Sound Effects Support. Sound effects licensed under CC BY-SA 2.0 DEED, no secondary processing.
about.creditsCountdownSpeech: Chinese countdown speech material. Users in Taiwan are welcome to download for a more stable warning experience.
about.aboutIntensity: About Intensity: China (Mainland), Hong Kong, Macau, and Korea use the intensity scale (12-level, I~XII). Japan and Taiwan use the shindo scale (10-level, 0~7, with levels 5 and 6 split into Lower/Upper). Some values are estimated, not measured.
about.aboutTime: About Time: Except for global networks (USGS, FSSN) which display China Standard Time, all others display local time of the issuing agency.
about.aboutDelay: About Delay: Due to API and server limitations, some data may have latency. This is normal.
about.aboutMap: About Map: Due to server bandwidth limitations, the map may take some time to load after entering the page. If the map doesn't load for a long time, please refresh the page.

customInstructions.title: The application supports custom sound effects. Please follow these steps:
customInstructions.step1: 1. Click the "Open Audio Folder" button. Your system's file manager will open the app's audio folder.
customInstructions.step2: 2. Place the audio file you want to replace (must be MP3 format) into the folder and rename it to "xxx.mp3". Refer to the button labels below for the exact names.
customInstructions.step3: 3. Click the "Reload Audio" button, or right-click and refresh the page to complete the replacement.
customInstructions.testInfo: After replacement, click the buttons below to test the sound effects. To restore defaults, delete the corresponding MP3 file and reload audio.
customInstructions.tip: Tip: To disable a sound effect, create an empty text file and rename it to "xxx.mp3".
customInstructions.disclaimer: Any copyright infringement caused by this feature shall be borne by you. The developer assumes no responsibility.
